name: Databasus v3 Postgres Backups and Restore
description: Scheduled database backups to S3 with a dashboard, alerts and restore.

Databasus.startCommand: /bin/bash -c 'set -eu; if ! grep -Eq "^[[:space:]]*exec gosu databasus [.]/main[[:space:]]*$" /app/start.sh; then echo "railway: unexpected /app/start.sh (no exec gosu databasus ./main), refusing to start without the admin bootstrap" >&2; exit 1; fi; RAILWAY_REAL_GOSU="$(command -v gosu)"; export RAILWAY_REAL_GOSU; railway_pg_stop() { "$RAILWAY_REAL_GOSU" databasus /usr/lib/postgresql/17/bin/pg_ctl -D /databasus-data/pgdata -m fast -w -t 30 stop || true; }; railway_bootstrap() { local marker=/databasus-data/.railway-admin-bootstrapped; if [ -f "$marker" ]; then echo "railway: admin already provisioned on this volume"; return 0; fi; local email="${DATABASUS_ADMIN_EMAIL:-}"; local password="${DATABASUS_ADMIN_PASSWORD:-}"; if [ -z "$email" ] || [ -z "$password" ]; then echo "railway: DATABASUS_ADMIN_EMAIL and DATABASUS_ADMIN_PASSWORD are required, refusing to start without an administrator" >&2; return 1; fi; echo "railway: creating admin $email before the web server starts"; if ! "$RAILWAY_REAL_GOSU" databasus ./main --create-user --email="$email" --password="$password" --role=admin; then echo "railway: admin creation failed, see the error above" >&2; return 1; fi; if [ "${DATABASUS_DISABLE_SIGNUP:-true}" = "true" ]; then if ! /usr/lib/postgresql/17/bin/psql -X -q -1 -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -d "$DATABASE_DSN" -c "INSERT INTO users_settings (is_allow_external_registrations) SELECT false WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users_settings)" -c "UPDATE users_settings SET is_allow_external_registrations = false"; then echo "railway: could not turn off sign-up, set DATABASUS_DISABLE_SIGNUP=false to skip this step" >&2; return 1; fi; echo "railway: open sign-up turned off (an admin can turn it back on in Databasus settings)"; fi; "$RAILWAY_REAL_GOSU" databasus touch "$marker"; }; railway_on_term() { if [ -n "${RAILWAY_MAIN_PID:-}" ]; then kill -TERM "$RAILWAY_MAIN_PID" 2>/dev/null || true; fi; }; railway_run_main() { trap railway_on_term TERM INT; "$RAILWAY_REAL_GOSU" databasus ./main & RAILWAY_MAIN_PID=$!; local status=0; wait "$RAILWAY_MAIN_PID" || status=$?; while kill -0 "$RAILWAY_MAIN_PID" 2>/dev/null; do status=0; wait "$RAILWAY_MAIN_PID" || status=$?; done; echo "railway: Databasus exited with status $status, stopping embedded PostgreSQL"; railway_pg_stop; exit "$status"; }; railway_shim() { if [ "$#" -eq 2 ] && [ "$1" = databasus ] && [ "$2" = ./main ]; then if ! railway_bootstrap; then railway_pg_stop; exit 1; fi; railway_run_main; fi; exec "$RAILWAY_REAL_GOSU" "$@"; }; mkdir -p /tmp/railway-gosu-shim; { echo "#!/bin/bash"; declare -f railway_pg_stop railway_bootstrap railway_on_term railway_run_main railway_shim; echo "railway_shim \"\$@\""; } > /tmp/railway-gosu-shim/gosu; chmod 0755 /tmp/railway-gosu-shim/gosu; export PATH="/tmp/railway-gosu-shim:$PATH"; exec /app/start.sh'

PORT.description: Port Railway routes the public domain and the healthcheck to. Databasus always listens on 4005; keep this value.

DATABASUS_ADMIN_EMAIL.description: Required. Your email: the administrator account is created with it on first boot, before the dashboard goes online. You sign in with it.

DATABASUS_ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Initial administrator password, generated at deploy. Read on first boot only; change it later under your Databasus profile.

DATABASUS_DISABLE_SIGNUP.description: true = turn off open self-registration on first boot, so only users you invite can join. Applied once, together with the admin bootstrap.

DATABASUS_URL.description: Public URL of this instance, used in invitation and sign-in emails.

LOG_FILE_IS_ENABLED.description: false = log to stdout only (Railway keeps the logs). true also writes a rotating databasus.log on the volume.

LOG_LEVEL.description: Log level: debug, info, warn or error.

IS_DISABLE_ANONYMOUS_TELEMETRY.description: Databasus sends anonymous usage telemetry by default (upstream default). Set true to opt out.

SMTP_HOST.description: Optional instance mail server for invitations, password reset and sign-in codes. Railway allows outbound SMTP on the Pro plan only.

SMTP_PORT.description: Optional. SMTP port, e.g. 587 or 465. Required when SMTP_HOST is set.

SMTP_SECURITY.description: Optional. tls, starttls or none. Empty = tls on port 465, starttls on any other port.

SMTP_PASSWORD.description: Optional. SMTP password or API key.

SMTP_FROM.description: Optional. Sender address, e.g. noreply@your-domain.com. Empty = SMTP_USER if it is an address.

S3_ENDPOINT.description: Railway Bucket endpoint. Not read by Databasus: paste it into Storages, S3, Endpoint.

S3_BUCKET.description: Railway Bucket name for the S3 API. Not read by Databasus: paste it into Storages, S3, Bucket.

S3_REGION.description: Railway Bucket region (auto). Not read by Databasus: paste it into Storages, S3, Region.

S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID.description: Railway Bucket access key. Not read by Databasus: paste it into Storages, S3, Access key.

S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY.description: Railway Bucket secret key. Not read by Databasus: paste it into Storages, S3, Secret key.

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Time between SIGTERM and SIGKILL, so Databasus and its embedded PostgreSQL shut down cleanly on redeploy.
